_comment: All static UI strings. Key once, two languages. Add new keys as needed.

tending_fert_none.zh: 没有化肥了，去商城买一袋吧
tending_fert_none.en: No fertilizer left — grab a bag in the shop

tending_fert_toast.zh: 🌟 施好肥，这块地收获翻倍！

steal_done.zh: 🧺 从 {name} 家顺了一棵，已入库

steal_daily_cap.zh: 今天顺得够多啦，明天再来～
steal_daily_cap.en: You've grabbed plenty today — back tomorrow!

steal_target_cap.zh: 在这家就顺这么多啦，去别家逛逛～
steal_target_cap.en: Enough from this neighbor — visit others!

steal_warehouse_full.zh: 仓库满了，先去卖菜再来顺～
steal_warehouse_full.en: Silo's full — sell some crops first!

report_help_water.zh: {name} 帮你浇了水，{crop}长得更快了

report_caught.zh: 看家狗逮住了来串门的 {name}，TA 赔了你 1 棵{crop}！
report_caught.en: Your dog caught {name} sneaking in — they left you 1 {crop}!

report_visit_more.zh: 还有 {n} 位邻居也来逛过～

toast_level_up.zh: 等级提升! 解锁新内容

tasks_all_done.zh: 今日任务全部完成! 明天见 ✨
tasks_all_done.en: All done for today! See you tomorrow ✨

rewards_subtitle.zh: 兑换真实的东方超市优惠券
rewards_subtitle.en: Exchange for real Eastern Market coupons

rewards_code_instruction.zh: 结账时给收银员看这个码即可

settings_reset_confirm.zh: 确定要重置吗? 进度无法恢复.
settings_reset_confirm.en: Reset progress? This cannot be undone.

about_made_by.zh: 本游戏由东方超市制作

about_visit_us.zh: 欢迎光临 Saskatoon 东方超市
about_visit_us.en: Visit us at Eastern Market, Saskatoon

tutorial_subtitle.zh: 三步上手，今天就能收菜

tutorial_step1_body.zh: 棕色地块就是你的菜地。已经给你 3 种种子，点一下就能种。
tutorial_step1_body.en: Brown squares are your plots. You start with 3 seed types — tap to plant.

tutorial_step2_body.zh: 种子会自己长大（最快约 5 分钟）。等的时候先逛逛任务和商店，回来正好收。
tutorial_step2_body.en: Crops grow on their own (fastest ~5 min). Browse the tasks & shop while you wait.

tutorial_step3_body.zh: 收的菜先进仓库，攒一批后送到东方超市，换农场币和超市积分。
tutorial_step3_body.en: Harvested crops go to the silo. Deliver to Eastern Market for coins + Store Points.

toast_first_plant.zh: 🌱 种下第一棵菜！开张大吉 +10 农场币
toast_first_plant.en: 🌱 Your first seed! +10 coins to start

toast_first_harvest.zh: 🎉 第一次收获！进仓库的菜可以送去东方超市
toast_first_harvest.en: 🎉 First harvest! Deliver from the silo to Eastern Market

harvest_status_empty.en: 🌱 Your plots are empty — plant something!

_storekeeper_pool_default_zh: 新手提示：点棕色地块种第一粒种子。
作物成熟会发绿光，点一下就收到仓库。
上海苗只要 5 分钟，新手最快上手。
韭菜种一次能割 3 次，性价比高。
莲藕要长 5 小时，但卖价 C400，长线投资。
收获后菜进仓库，点谷仓卖给东方超市才能换金币。
今日首单卖给东方超市有 +20% 奖励，记得早卖。
仓库装满 20 件就不能再收，先卖给东方超市或花钱扩建。
看种植弹窗的「市场收购价」就知道这棵菜值多少。
完成每天 3 个任务，奖励积分自动到账。
走访 3 户邻居 → 送 5 积分。
给邻居点赞自己也得 1 积分，每天最多 5 个。
排行榜每周一刷新，多种菜往上爬。
积分商城新到了灯笼装饰，看看？
买加速券可以让作物立刻成熟，关键时刻用。
等级越高解锁更多作物，努力升级！
累了关掉游戏，作物在地里会继续长。
东方超市 10am-6:30pm，周日休息。
我们店在 133-412 Willowgrove Square。
店里 2000+ 种亚洲食材，欢迎周末来逛。
莴笋、韭菜、香菜、白萝卜——都是店里热销前 10。
游戏里的菜，店里都有真货。
超市积分在农场能够换加速券、装饰、宠物、扩地块，也可跟农场币互换。或者攒着到超市里用。
设置里可以改自己的昵称，让邻居认得你。
下载这个游戏不要钱，玩起来也不收费。
_storekeeper_pool_default_en: Tip: tap any brown plot to plant your first seed.
Mature crops glow green. Tap to harvest into the silo.
Shanghai bok choy is the fastest — only 5 minutes.
Chinese chives can be cut 3 times from one planting.
Lotus root takes 5 hours but sells for C400. Long-game.
Harvested crops go to your silo. Sell to Eastern Market for coins.
Daily 1st sale gets +20% bonus. Don't sit on the silo.
Silo holds 20. Hit the cap and you can't harvest more — sell first or expand.
Check the 'Market price' label in the plant picker to compare crops.
Finish 3 daily tasks to earn bonus points.
Visit 3 neighbors → +5 points.
Like a neighbor and you get +1 point too. Cap 5/day.
Leaderboard resets every Monday. Grow more to climb up.
New lanterns in the shop. Take a look.
Acceleration tickets ripen a crop instantly. Save them for the right moment.
Higher level unlocks more crops. Keep planting!
Close the app and your crops keep growing.
Eastern Market hours: 10am-6:30pm Mon-Sat. Closed Sunday.
We're at 133-412 Willowgrove Square in Saskatoon.
2,000+ Asian groceries in store. Come visit on a weekend.
Celtuce, chives, cilantro, daikon — all top-10 sellers in store.
Every crop in this game is real produce we stock.
Store Points work right in the farm — boosts, decorations, pets, more plots, and swap with coins. Or save them up to use at the store.
Set a nickname in settings so neighbors recognize you.
This game is free to play, no paywalls.
